title: Star Pyramid
story: The festival stage lights form a pyramid. Print it for any height.
goal: Read n. Print n rows: row 1 has 1 star, row 2 has 2 stars, up to n.
starter:
n = int(input())
# print a pyramid of stars
hints: One loop runs once per row. How many stars does row i need?
socratic: How many stars belong in row 4?
Is there a shortcut to repeat a string?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Star Pyramid”?

clean.label: Use one loop only (skip the inner loop)
